title: Permanental Inequalities and Unit Interval Orders
summary: Given a square matrix, the permanent is a determinant-like function without signs. In this paper, we study inequalities involving permanents of certain submatrices. We first focus on a family of zero-one totally nonnegative matrices that arise as anti-adjacency matrices of unit interval orders. For these matrices, we prove a collection of inequalities comparing products of permanents of consecutive principal submatrices with products of permanents of parity-selected principal submatrices.
